Name: Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul
Author: Theoddon
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/IJZDsvh.png[/img][/center]
[center]﻿[/center]
﻿

Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul (SVBO) attempts to make more playstyles viable while bringing unbalanced ones down to reasonable levels. Almost every aspect of the game has been rebalanced: sell prices, shops, crafting recipes, artisan goods processing, monsters, buildings costs, food buffs, community center bundles, etc. Expect a faster early game, slower late game, and a much more rewarding and balanced experience designed with longer playstyles in mind.

[b]For the intended experience, a new save is required because existing item's sell prices cannot be changed. Make sure to set your desired Community Center bundles in the config [u]before[/u] creating a new save because bundles cannot easily be changed on existing saves. For more details see FAQ below.[/b]
[left][line]
[b][u]SVBO is fully modular.[/u][/b] Disabling all settings will make it do nothing. If you would like more in-depth information about the changes to specific items we have separate spreadsheets for the content we individually support.

[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15G_YB2n2Hh0fuSumpxEE2cR3Ppn6Ymy6AO2apHkjqeA/edit?gid=436191938#gid=436191938]Theoddon's Spreadsheet[/url]﻿ contains info related to [i]Vanilla[/i], [i]Stardew Valley Expanded[/i], [i]Ridgeside Village[/i], [i]East Scarp[/i] and[i] Love of Cooking[/i] as well as info related to [i]monster rebalance[/i], [i]museum rewards[/i], [i]bundles [/i]and more in-depth info regarding[i] crafting recipes and their changes[/i].

[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gaLpV6vQrGG99yOhuLZkISLcnJu5Zg5ubNFrYpYhK6w/edit?gid=1339942748#gid=1339942748]Minothilos Spreadsheet[/url]﻿ contains info related to all supported mods ([i]except [/i]Ridgeside Village and East Scarp)[i],[/i] including (but not limited to) [i]Cornucopia[/i] (all of them), [i]Animal Husbandry Mod[/i], [i]Mizu's Quail/Turkey[/i], [i]Milkable Sheep[/i] and [i]Binning[/i].

[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[/left]
[list]
[*]All crops and animals are now closer in profits and viable late game.[/*]
[*]Artisan Goods now have a chance to increase in quantity when using quality ingredients.[/*]
[*]Large animal products now produce 2 products when processed and scale with quality.[/*]
[*]Fish sell prices are now based on catch difficulty and have a flatter curve, resulting in more consistent profits.[/*]
[*]Buffs have been added to most food and most buff durations have been increased.[/*]
[*]Bundles are now slightly harder to complete but have much better rewards. [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] community bundles are also available.[/*]
[*]Artisan machines are harder to craft to help delay mid/late game. [i]3 difficulty options. [/i][/*]
[*]Food sell prices now match the base quality ingredients + 10% profit. Does not scale with higher quality ingredients.[/*]
[*]Shop prices and inventories have been adjusted so you can no longer get infinite food, seeds, and certain resources easily.[/*]
[*]Fruit trees require less investment and have faster pay off.[/*]
[*]Flowers prices have been flattened, making flower honey prices much closer together.[/*]
[*]Ancient Fruit and other rare crops can no longer be used in Seed Makers. However, offer higher profits than regular crops.[/*]
[*]Mines now have more consistent profits regardless of the floor you are on.[/*]
[*]Monster strength has been adjusted. [i]3 difficulty options. [/i][/*]
[*]Various recipes have been tweaked to make lesser used things more desirable, such as slime huts and tree tappers.[/*]
[*]Crafting bait, bombs, fertilizers, lures, and warp totems is now more sustainable. [/*]
[*]Buildings & Animal costs have been adjusted.[/*]
[*]Some Monster Eradication Goals require less grinding and some monster drops have been changed.[/*]
[*]Museum rewards are now in a better order and more rewarding.[/*]
[*]Seed Maker and Bait Maker scale with ingredient quality.[/*]
[*]Giant crops drop seeds and scale to player farming level.[/*]
[*]Many more things![/*]
[/list][heading]Quality of Life Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Large animal products can now be split into smaller ones. Choose between recycling machine (more immersive) or hand crafting (faster).[/*]
[*]Willy buys fishing poles, Marnie buys shears & milk pails, Clint buys weapons and armor.[/*]
[*]Marnie sells Auto-Petter after Community Center completion.[/*]
[*]Harvey's Clinic sells life elixirs.[/*]
[*]Silo holds 1000 hay.[/*]
[/list][line]

[heading]Recommended Game Settings[/heading]
[list]
[*]Community Center Bundles: Normal. Remix bundles are not changed and cannot be added due to limitations with Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Mine Rewards: Normal or Remixed.[/*]
[*]Profit Margin: 100%. This mod already reduces late game profits significantly but you can lower this even further.[/*]
[/list][heading]Warnings / Notes[/heading]
[list]
[*]This mod should work with pretty much any mod. However, [i]unsupported[/i] mods that add shops / machines / crops / fish / animals / recipes / etc are not recommended for the best experience. It is easy to break intended balance by adding unintended mods. If you have doubt, ask in comment section.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21278]Artisan Goods Keep Quality[/url] and similar mods will give you far more profit than intended. We recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk of Life[/url] for a more balanced profession-based approached. Disable [b]SVBO's Artisan Goods Processing [/b]if you want to use an unsupported mod's processing rules[b].[/b][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20660]Improved Shops[/url]﻿ / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21253]Shops Expanded[/url]﻿ and similar mods that adjust or add shops are not recommended. Disable all settings under [b]SVBO's Shops[/b] if you want to use an unsupported mod's shops.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2697]Skip Fishing Minigame[/url] is not recommended because fish prices are based on catch difficulty. However, if you [i]must[/i] skip fishing minigame, we suggest setting perfect catch chance to 50% or lower.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22672]Junimatic[/url]﻿ are known to cause issues with certain custom machine processing rules. In my brief testing, they worked fine. However, if you use automation we suggest setting [b]SVBO's Machines/Sprinklers [/b]to Hard or Very Hard. Alternatively, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk of Life[/url] instead, as it buffs vanilla hoppers to allow balanced end game automation.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720]Machine Progression System[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7767]﻿Crab Pot Loot Has Quality[/url]﻿ / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]Better Beehouses[/url]﻿ / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7554]Forage Fantasy[/url] and similar unsupported mods that adjust gameplay mechanics related to profits are not recommended. Depending on the mod, it could be minor or it could ruin game balance.[/*]
[*]Any combination of Cornucopia [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Crops[/url]﻿﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Flowers[/url]﻿ packs can be enabled. [/*]

[heading]FAQ[/heading]
[b]Will mods like UI Info Suite﻿ show the correct sell prices?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes.[/*]
[/list][b]Can you balance a certain mod?[/b]
[list]
[*]Adding mod support is a time consuming process that require maintenance due to mod updates. You can make a request and one of us might be up to balancing something, but it really depends on the scope of the mod. Large content mods that we don't play with are likely not to be balanced. You are free to make your own patches, content patcher is very learnable just by looking at the mod's files.[/*]
[/list][b]Something feels unbalanced, how should I report it?[/b]
[list]
[*]Please let us know what settings you are using and provide a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]﻿ so we can see what mods you are using.﻿[/*]
[/list][b]What config settings are safe to adjust on an existing save?[/b]
[list]
[*]Everything [u]except[/u] Sell Prices & Adjustments, Community Center Bundles, and Museum Rewards. Changing these on an existing save is unlikely to cause game breaking issues, but it will cause inconsistencies.[/*]
[/list][b]How do I change to different bundles on an existing save?[/b]
[list]
[*]Backup your save and use this with caution. This will completely reset your bundles and SMAPI warns it can cause issues. While your save is loaded, alt-tab out of the game and type [b]regenerate_bundles ignore_seed confirm[/b] into the SMAPI console.[/*]
[/list][b]I have a suggestion, can I request it?[/b]
[list]
[*]Absolutely![/*]
[/list]
